title: Shopping now starts with AI, and our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); Google launched Universal Cart in Search and Gemini; Newegg added Google UCP checkout; Amex built agent-authorization rails. Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% (Gartner).

points.headline: AI is becoming a mainstream way to discover products
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ) and Shopify data says AI discovery converts better than search. We should make our catalog AI-readable and track AI-sourced traffic separately.

points.headline: Agent checkout is going live across Google, Newegg and Amex
points.detail: Google launched Universal Cart in Search and Gemini, Newegg integrated Google UCP checkout, and Amex introduced authorization controls for agents. We should check feed and checkout readiness.

points.headline: PC volumes are collapsing while component costs lift prices
points.detail: Gartner reports Q3 PC shipments down 22.4% as component costs lifted ASPs; DigiTimes sees a 20%+ drop with inventory pressure. We should plan pricing, stock and promotions for the holidays.

points.headline: Holiday online demand keeps growing despite a cautious mood
points.detail: Adobe forecasts record US online holiday sales of $275.1B, up 6.7%, and Gartner finds 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gift ideas. We should plan Cyber 5 inventory and AI-friendly content.
